objective: Author item, equipment, weapon, armor, tool and loadout definitions plus vehicle, mount, companion, construct and modular-component packages with explicit slots, components, owner references and versioned compatibility while preserving owned Inventory and live platform/entity ownership.
acceptance: item/loadout definitions remain distinct from owned Inventory state
modular compatibility is explicit and versioned
boundaries: MRCS-01/03/04/05/08/11/12 remain the workspace, guided-authoring, bounded-expression, mechanical-definition and cross-domain package foundations consumed by this tranche.
Item, equipment, weapon, armor, tool and loadout records remain reusable definitions/packages; owned Inventory, equipped state, custody and live item instances remain external owner-domain authority.
Vehicle, mount, companion and construct definitions preserve explicit vehicle/platform/entity/creature owner references and cannot create or mutate live owned entities.
Slots, components and modular compatibility must be explicit and versioned; unknown or unsupported compatibility remains unresolved rather than inferred.
Actions, effects, conditions, resources and capabilities remain references to their owning domains and are not copied into a parallel MRCS runtime.
MRCS-14+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
